title: Leon Cooperman - Looking For More For Less
summary:
After getting his MBA from Columbia Business
School, Leon joined Goldman Sachs as a Junior Analyst and
ultimately built up Goldman Sachs' asset management division, GSAM. In 1991 Leon decided to follow his passion for money management and
started his hedge fund, Omega Advisors, which became a family
office in 2018. Leon is a member of The Giving Pledge and he takes
great pleasure in giving back to those organizations and
institutions that made a difference in his life.
